title: Leave My Pets Alone
description: Makes wolf armor protect against a /kill
body:
# Description Makes wolf armor protect against /kill @e It will take one hit and break, so running the command twice will still kill. Protects against accidental murders while clearing unwanted entities, although you'll have to replace the armor so your wolf lives. # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21 - 26.1.2 (older versions untested)
On older versions, instead of breaking wolf armor, /kill resets it's durability for some reason. # Compatibility Incompatible with any use of the wolf armor damage type tag. Must be above all packs that do that.
